buildCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable /tmp/flutter && export PATH="/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter config --enable-web && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL="$SUPABASE_URL" --dart-define=SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY="$SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY"
